Mira: Quick check-in: we need a prioritized intake rubric for the next design partner wave. Key asks: how do we decide which partners get the "expedited onboarding" vs the normal lane, and what launch criteria unlock a public beta?
Alex: My take: prioritize by product fit (high-value integrations), technical readiness, and compliance needs. expedited only if fit+readiness are both high.
Ravi: Add cost-risk signal: expected sustained tokens/day. If cost > threshold and model isn't quantized, push to scoped pilot, not expedited.
Tess: For public beta gating: 1) 3 partners from different verticals signed, 2) <20% onboarding drop-off, 3) no P1 bugs in 2 weeks.
Mira: Scope negotiation: require partners to agree to a 6-week feedback cadenced commitment, sample prompts, and a small telemetry share. Is that feasible?
Alex: Yes but flag: legal may need narrower telemetry language for finance/healthcare.
InfraBot: Note: expedited path needs 4 reserved GPU-hours/week per partner; current pool supports 6 expedited partners.
Ravi: Action items: Alex to draft intake rubric (rules + scoring) by Thu; Tess to enumerate beta gating metrics; Infra to confirm capacity by EOD.
Mira: Also keep onboarding templates minimal. we'll avoid heavy custom integrations for expedited unless partner pays for concierge. Reopen after rubric draft.
